title: Rayleigh and Raman scattering
caption: Light briefly lifts a molecule to a short-lived virtual state. Most photons scatter with unchanged energy (Rayleigh). A few leave the molecule one vibrational level higher and come out with less energy (Stokes), or take a level's energy away and come out with more (anti-Stokes). The shifts measure vibrational energies.
alt: Energy diagram: v = 0 and v = 1 levels and a dashed virtual level; arrows for Rayleigh, Stokes and anti-Stokes scattering.
description: Rayleigh: up from v = 0 and back to v = 0, same energy.
Stokes: up from v = 0, down to v = 1: scattered light of lower energy.
Anti-Stokes: up from v = 1, down to v = 0: higher energy.

claims.name: Stokes light has less energy than the incident light
anti-Stokes light has more energy than the incident light
Rayleigh light has the same energy as the incident light
